source_goal: Fix proof-update command binding and host-proof boundary expansion: (1) Replace positional command/tier lists with explicit structured bindings so one command can prove multiple tiers; (2) Add in-place host-proof boundary expansion without restart to unblock awaiting-approval plans when audit detects required higher tiers

requirements.statement: proof-update command binding must use explicit structured format instead of positional lists
requirements.outcome: One command can prove multiple tiers without positional mapping failure (e.g., cmd-xxx covers unit+contract+behaviour)
scope: scripts/planning-revision.py - proof-update kind handler and validation
requirements.constraint: Backward compatibility: must support old positional format during transition
acceptance_criteria: proof-update accepts checks array with explicit {command, tiers} binding
Validation rejects loose command/tiers lists at command boundary
execution-evidence reads explicit binding instead of positional mapping
Start Report shows one command × multiple tiers correctly

requirements.statement: host-proof boundary must support in-place expansion without restart
requirements.outcome: When planning audit detects inferred tiers exceeding host boundary, awaiting-approval plan can expand tier list without restarting
scope: scripts/task-start.py - boundary enforcement with new tier set
requirements.constraint: Expansion must re-run audit to verify new boundary clears conflicts
acceptance_criteria: planning revise accepts proof-boundary-expand change kind
Expansion merges new allowed_tiers into run anchor
Audit re-runs and reports clean after boundary expansion
No restart or plan rejection required

evidence.detail: proof-update revision tiers do not update per-command checks[] entry created at Start time; execution matches checks[] first and ignores broader tier list, rejecting new tiers
Anchor generation at Start time does not auto-populate proof-only test file implications; run approved without manual proof-update closes evidence-incomplete; fix exists but is opt-in, not automatic

evidence.finding: inferred-tier-conflicts-host-proof-boundary conflict type reports restart-required with no in-place expansion command

questions.question: Should old proof-update format (separate commands/tiers lists) be deprecated with migration warning or supported indefinitely?
Should boundary expansion automatically re-run audit or require explicit user request?
